title: LastMines
description: A plugin for automines with flexible customization for versions 1.16.5–26.1.2
body:
This is a powerful plugin for creating auto-miners, offering extensive customisation options and flexible configuration.

Features and functions of the plugin:
- Create an unlimited number of auto-miners
- Debug messages (for developers)
- Support for MiniMessage, Hex, and Legacy color formats
- Support for messages for various actions
- Migration between popular auto-miner plugins
- Upgrade to the next rarity without upgrading the auto-miner itself
- Unique drop from any block when it is broken
- Support for a customizable GUI menu
- Support for minimum and maximum block count limits in the auto-mine (conflicts with the `chance` section)
- 3 hologram providers (TextDisplay (Vanilla), [FancyHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancyholograms/versions), and [DecentHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/decentholograms/versions))
- Online limit for auto-mine operation

# Dependencies:

- [BLibV2](https://github.com/By1337/BLibV2/releases)
- [PlaceholderAPI](https://github.com/PlaceholderAPI/PlaceholderAPI/releases), [BMenu](https://github.com/By1337/BMenu/releases), [WorldEdit](https://modrinth.com/plugin/worldedit/versions)/[FAWE](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fastasyncworldedit/versions), [DecentHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/decentholograms/versions)/[FancyHolograms](https://modrinth.com/plugin/fancyholograms/versions) (опционально)
